A '''Zabrak deseret mat''' was a type of mat. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Master in Violet]] kept a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] desert mat in the [[Violet Gallery]] of the [[Five Masters Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], using the mat for duels and trials of advancement.
